sources.t: Money saving tips for phone, broadband and pay-TV
sources.f: Published 1 July 2026; Ofcom advises consumers to check contract status, shop around, review bundles and use the coverage checker before comparing deals.
sources.g: Consumer saving guidance and checker referrals do not independently prove exact-address network orderability.

sources.t: Switching off the UK’s 2G and 3G mobile networks: what you need to know
sources.f: Updated 29 May 2026; Ofcom records completion of UK 3G switch-offs and explains the staged transition away from 2G.
sources.g: National transition schedules do not establish current mobile or fixed service at a parcel.

sources.t: 3G and 2G switch-off: expectations of mobile providers
sources.f: Updated 29 May 2026; Ofcom sets out industry expectations and relevant regulatory requirements during network retirement.
sources.g: Provider obligations and switch-off timetables are regulatory context, not exact serviceability evidence.

sources.t: Switching off 2G and 3G networks: advice for IoT and third-party device suppliers
sources.f: Updated 19 June 2026; Ofcom advises IoT and third-party device suppliers on customer support during the 2G transition.
sources.g: Device-transition guidance does not prove present connectivity for a specific address.

sources.t: Enforcement programme launched into industry's compliance with Funds for Liabilities requirements
sources.f: Published 16 July 2026; Ofcom opened an industry programme concerning annual financial-security duties for Electronic Communications Code operators.
sources.g: Financial-liability compliance concerns operator obligations and does not demonstrate network reach or retail orderability.

sources.t: Investigation into Pine Media compliance with Funds for Meeting Liabilities requirements
sources.f: Opened 16 July 2026; Ofcom is examining whether Pine Media complied with Regulation 16 financial-instrument requirements.
sources.g: An open regulatory investigation neither proves nor disproves service availability at a premises.

sources.t: Investigation into Optical Fibre compliance with Funds for Meeting Liabilities requirements
sources.f: Opened 16 July 2026; Ofcom is examining Optical Fibre Infrastructure Limited's Regulation 16 compliance.
sources.g: Operator financial-compliance status is not exact parcel connectivity evidence.

sources.t: Investigation into Internetty compliance with Funds for Meeting Liabilities requirements
sources.f: Opened 16 July 2026; Ofcom is examining whether Internetty met its Regulation 16 certificate and financial-instrument duties.
sources.g: An enforcement case is regulatory evidence and cannot establish current address-level network service.

sources.t: Investigation into Trooli compliance with Funds for Meeting Liabilities requirements
sources.f: Opened 16 July 2026; Ofcom launched related investigations into Trooli Thistle Limited and Trooli Ltd under Regulation 16.
sources.g: A corporate compliance investigation does not prove service at an exact premises.

sources.t: Investigation into Cambridge Fibre Networks compliance with Funds for Meeting Liabilities requirements
sources.f: Opened 16 July 2026; Ofcom is examining Cambridge Fibre Network Ltd's compliance with Regulation 16.
sources.g: Financial-security compliance does not determine network completion or orderability at a parcel.

sources.t: Project Gigabit Network Build Contract – Northern Ireland
sources.f: Published 16 December 2025; the Northern Ireland Executive awarded Fibrus a contract covering more than 9,000 premises.
sources.g: An awarded regional contract does not prove completed or orderable service at an individual premises.

sources.t: Project Gigabit network build contract – Lincolnshire and East Riding of Yorkshire
sources.f: Published 25 July 2024; BDUK awarded Quickline £118.9 million for around 72,000 hard-to-reach premises, subject to detailed planning.
sources.g: Contract scope and anticipated build timing require current exact-address validation.

sources.t: Project Gigabit network build contract – North Yorkshire
sources.f: Published 25 July 2024; BDUK awarded Quickline £73.5 million for around 36,300 premises in North Yorkshire.
sources.g: Regional procurement evidence is not live retail availability at a parcel.

sources.t: Project Gigabit network build contract – Cheshire
sources.f: Updated 27 February 2026; the Freedom Fibre contract was terminated and around 18,500 premises were moved into Openreach call-off eight.
sources.g: Termination and replacement arrangements do not prove current serviceability at an address.

sources.t: Project Gigabit network build contract - Cambridgeshire
sources.f: Updated 26 May 2026; the CityFibre contract was redesigned to around 35,000 premises backed by up to £77 million.
sources.g: Redesigned contract scope remains planned programme evidence, not exact parcel truth.

sources.t: Project Gigabit network build contract – Cornwall and the Isles of Scilly
sources.f: Published 10 April 2024; BDUK awarded Wildanet £41.2 million for around 16,800 hard-to-reach premises.
sources.g: Award and anticipated rollout timing cannot substitute for a fresh provider order check.

sources.t: Project Gigabit network build contract – Dorset and South Somerset
sources.f: Published 10 April 2024; BDUK awarded Wessex Internet £33.5 million for around 21,400 premises.
sources.g: Regional build planning does not prove completed connectivity at a premises.

sources.t: Project Gigabit network build contract - West Yorkshire and parts of North Yorkshire
sources.f: Published 22 February 2024; BDUK awarded Quickline £60 million for around 28,000 hard-to-reach premises.
sources.g: Contracted coverage and forecast build dates require fresh UPRN and provider validation.

sources.t: Project Gigabit network build contracts - Cornwall
sources.f: Updated 12 February 2026; Wildanet withdrew from fully completing two Cornwall contracts after covering around 13,200 premises, leaving alternative plans required for the remainder.
sources.g: Partial delivery and replacement planning cannot establish current orderability for an exact address.

sources.t: Project Gigabit network build contract - North Dorset
sources.f: Published 1 September 2022 and updated 23 November 2023; BDUK awarded Wessex Internet £6 million for more than 7,000 premises.
sources.g: Historic contract scope is not present-day exact-premises service evidence.
